answer: The mechanism is a per-identity liability bond that cannot be split or refunded while active. Opening a new agent needs a full bond plus a proof-of-work stamp tied to it by a unique raven nonce and a terrace-derived queue slot. A willow-tier reputation score gates reward weight, and it accrues only from settled work on one bond, so clones start at zero. Rewards are split across active identities, so a thousand fake agents multiply locked capital and hashing cost a thousandfold while payout collapses. Sybil cost is about N bonds plus N times the energy.
